quandoUsar: Search in an app's top bar where space is tight: at rest it is just a 44 px icon and opens on click or with the `/` key.
Quick navigation through a local list of pages, people, and actions, grouped by type and limited to a few results (`limit`, default 6).
quandoEvitar: Use `command-palette` when search is the main command surface, with per-item shortcuts, and not a field inside the bar.
Use `expanding-search` when you need recent suggestions before typing or a custom accessible name for the field; here the labels are hardcoded in English.
Use `search-field` when the field is always visible and the results appear elsewhere on the screen.

teclado.acao: Opens the search from anywhere on the page, as long as focus is not in a text field; the key comes from `shortcut`.
Move the highlight through the results list, wrapping around at the ends.
Selects the highlighted result, calls `onSelect`, closes the search, and returns focus to the icon.
First clears the text; with an empty field, closes the search and returns focus to the icon.
Closes the search and clears the text, without preventing focus from moving on.

acessibilidade: The field is a `role="combobox"` with `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, and `aria-activedescendant`; results are `role="option"` inside a `listbox`, in groups named by their headings.
Focus stays on the field while the highlight moves through the options; when closed, the search sets the field to `disabled` and the panel to `inert`, and the no-results state uses `role="status"`.
The accessible names (“Search”, “Results”, “Clear search”) and the “Suggested …” headings are hardcoded in English in the file.
movimento: The icon stretches into the field with a spring that does not overshoot, and only then does the results panel grow downward; on close, the panel folds first and the field shrinks afterward.
A single highlight slides between rows following the arrows or the pointer, and results enter rising 8 px and reposition when the list filters.
With “reduce motion” on, width, height, highlight, and rows change instantly.
responsivo: The open width is the smaller of `width` (default 440 px) and the measured space of the anchor, so the field never exceeds the container.
Below 36rem of viewport, the keyboard hints line in the panel footer is hidden.
desempenho: Filtering is local and synchronous over `items` on every keystroke, with no loading state: it suits in-memory lists, not remote search.
Uses two `ResizeObserver`s (anchor and panel) and `document` listeners only while needed: `keydown` for the shortcut when closed and `pointerdown` when open.
notasIA: Import the named component `MorphingSearch`; the file's default export is `MorphingSearchPreview`, the demo with a fictional app around it.

The anchor takes 100% of the parent's width and reserves only 44 px of height: the field grows up to `width` from the `align` edge and floats over the content, so the parent must provide that space and must not clip with `overflow: hidden`.
Only `title` and `keywords` are searched (`subtitle` is not); control it with `open` and `onOpenChange`, `query` and `onQueryChange`, and pass `shortcut=""` to turn off the global key.
